headline: EU Approves €1.7 Billion Payment to Bulgaria Under Recovery Plan
summary: The European Commission approved Bulgaria's fifth payment under its Recovery and Resilience Plan, worth more than €1.7 billion. The country is close to securing 99% of its allocated funding, after completing more than 50 reforms and investments.
why: Recovery and Resilience Facility payments are EU grants and loans tied to reforms, and they support public investment in member states such as Bulgaria.
